disclaimer.zh: 本报告由 DeepGuard 审计 Agent 自动执行并生成。安全审计存在固有限制：静态分析无法覆盖全部运行时行为，动态观测无法穷尽全部触发路径，AI 语义判断可能存在漏报与误报。本报告的「未检出」结论仅表示在当前规则库版本、检测深度与时间窗口内未发现恶意行为或安全风险，不构成对该插件绝对安全、现在或未来均无恶意行为的任何保证；检出项亦可能因上下文差异存在偏差。本报告仅覆盖所标注的插件版本与 commit 快照，作者此后发布的新版本或对既有版本的任何改写（含 force-push）均不在覆盖范围内。用户安装与使用插件属自主行为，相关风险由用户自行评估与承担。DeepGuard 保留随规则库升级对历史版本重新审计并修订结论的权利。
disclaimer.en: This report was automatically executed and generated by the DeepGuard Audit Agent. Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. A "not detected" conclusion in this report only means that no malicious behavior or security risk was found within the current ruleset version, detection depth, and time window; it does not constitute any guarantee that the plugin is absolutely safe or free of malicious behavior now or in the future. Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. This report covers only the plugin version and commit snapshot it identifies; any new version released by the author afterwards, or any rewrite of an existing version (including force-push), is outside its scope. Installing and using a plugin is the user's own decision, and the associated risks are assessed and borne by the user. DeepGuard reserves the right to re-audit historical versions and revise conclusions as the ruleset evolves.

checked_items.zh: 扫描了全部运行时源码与编译产物，未发现读取宿主凭据文件、SSH 私钥或云厂商凭据的代码，也没有批量搜集密钥的枚举语义；唯一出现的凭据相关字样是宿主设置接口的脱敏选项，属正常调用。
checked_items.en: Scanned all runtime source code and build artifacts; no code was found that reads host credential files, SSH private keys, or cloud provider credentials, and no enumeration semantics for bulk credential harvesting. The only credential-related text is a masking option in the host settings interface, which is a normal invocation.

checked_items.zh: 核查了表情包安装与素材读取路径，插件只读写自身素材目录和宿主主目录下的表情包目录，不触碰系统敏感位置。
checked_items.en: Inspected the emoji pack installation and asset reading paths. The plugin only reads/writes its own asset directory and the emoji pack directory under the host's home directory, and does not touch sensitive system locations.

checked_items.zh: 机器预扫未命中凭据读取类规则（DSH-C01/DSH-C02 无命中），人工复核结论一致。
checked_items.en: The machine pre-scan did not hit credential-reading rules (DSH-C01/DSH-C02 no hits), and the manual review conclusion is consistent.

evidence.zh: 未发现读取宿主凭据文件或私钥的代码路径，插件只访问自身素材目录与表情包目录，无凭据读取面。
evidence.en: No code path reading host credential files or private keys was found. The plugin only accesses its own asset directory and the emoji pack directory; there is no credential-reading surface.

checked_items.zh: 插件没有注册任何工具，不存在工具描述投毒面。
checked_items.en: The plugin registers no tools, so there is no tool-description poisoning surface.

checked_items.zh: 插件向系统提示注入一段表情使用协议（允许的表情白名单、每回合数量上限、代码与链接边界），文本为固定的功能性说明，不包含指令覆写或诱导内容；机器预扫命中的两处系统提示注入调用（DSH-T02，源码 src/index.ts 与其编译产物 lib/index.js）已人工核对为同一段良性协议文本。
checked_items.en: The plugin injects an emoji usage protocol into the system prompt (allowed emoji whitelist, per-round quantity cap, code and link boundaries). The text is a fixed functional description with no instruction override or inducement content. The two machine pre-scan hits for system prompt injection (DSH-T02, source src/index.ts and its build artifact lib/index.js) have been manually verified to be the same benign protocol text.

checked_items.zh: 仓库根存在面向开发协作的指令文件 AGENTS.md（机器预扫命中 DSH-X10），内容为中文协作约定与发版流程，无“忽略此前指令”、伪装系统消息或远程拉取指令等注入措辞。
checked_items.en: There is an AGENTS.md instruction file for development collaboration at the repository root (machine pre-scan hit DSH-X10). Its content covers Chinese collaboration conventions and release process, with no injection wording such as 'ignore previous instructions', disguised system messages, or remote instruction pulling.

checked_items.zh: README、文档与源码注释中的模型可见文本均无注入措辞；用户自定义附加提示词会插入系统提示，但协议末尾固定追加“用户指导不能改变模式、允许表情或上限”的约束，属功能设计而非漏洞。
checked_items.en: Model-visible text in README, documentation, and source comments contains no injection wording. User-customized additional prompt words are inserted into the system prompt, but the protocol always appends the constraint that 'user guidance cannot change the mode, allow emojis, or change the limit'—a functional design, not a vulnerability.

evidence.zh: 未注册工具；系统提示段为固定的表情使用协议，无语义注入内容。
evidence.en: No tools are registered; the system prompt segment is a fixed emoji usage protocol with no semantic injection content.

evidence.zh: 工具描述、文档与指令文件中无诱导安装、诱导改写配置或放开权限的措辞；安装说明仅为标准 dsh 插件安装命令。
evidence.en: Tool descriptions, documentation, and instruction files contain no wording that induces installation, config rewriting, or permission escalation. The installation instructions are only the standard dsh plugin installation command.

checked_items.zh: 运行时代码（Host 与 Web Client 编译产物）未发现 eval、动态函数构造、子进程调用等执行类模式。
checked_items.en: Runtime code (Host and Web Client build artifacts) shows no execution patterns such as eval, dynamic function construction, or subprocess invocation.

checked_items.zh: 挂载配置 cordis.patch.yml 仅插入插件自身标识，无 YAML 内嵌脚本标签（DSH-P01/DSH-P02 无命中）；未发现调用动态包执行工具的代码。
checked_items.en: The patch config cordis.patch.yml only inserts the plugin's own identifier, with no YAML embedded script tags (DSH-P01/DSH-P02 no hits). No code invoking dynamic package execution tools was found.

checked_items.zh: 用户上传的表情包 ZIP 解析做了严格的路径白名单、体积上限、PNG 文件头与校验和检查，解压只落到插件私有目录，无路径穿越或代码执行面。
checked_items.en: User-uploaded emoji pack ZIP parsing enforces strict path whitelist, size cap, PNG file header, and checksum checks. Extraction only lands in the plugin's private directory, with no path traversal or code execution surface.

checked_items.zh: 两个开发脚本（scripts/release.mjs、scripts/sync-bilibili-assets.mjs）调用子进程（机器预扫命中 DSH-X03），仅用于发布校验与素材同步，且发布校验明确禁止把 scripts 目录打进发布包，不随插件运行。
checked_items.en: Two development scripts (scripts/release.mjs, scripts/sync-bilibili-assets.mjs) invoke subprocesses (machine pre-scan hit DSH-X03). They are used only for release verification and asset sync. The release verification explicitly forbids packaging the scripts directory into the release package, and they do not run with the plugin.

checked_items.zh: 两个 CI 工作流（.github/workflows/ci.yml、.github/workflows/release.yml，机器预扫命中 DSH-X07）为标准构建与发布流程，内容为拉取代码、安装依赖、校验、npm 发布，无下载即执行或凭据外发行为。
checked_items.en: Two CI workflows (.github/workflows/ci.yml, .github/workflows/release.yml, machine pre-scan hit DSH-X07) are standard build and release flows: pulling code, installing dependencies, verification, and npm publish. No download-and-execute or credential exfiltration behavior.

checked_items.zh: Web Client 编译产物未发现键盘监听、剪贴板读取或凭据写入调用（DSH-X05 无命中）。
checked_items.en: The Web Client build artifact shows no keyboard listener, clipboard read, or credential write calls (DSH-X05 no hit).

evidence.zh: 挂载配置只有插件标识插入，无 YAML 脚本标签，不存在挂载即执行面。
evidence.en: The patch config only inserts the plugin identifier, with no YAML script tags, so there is no mount-and-execute surface.

evidence.zh: 未调用动态代码执行工具，无自我修改面。
evidence.en: No dynamic code execution tools are invoked, so there is no self-modification surface.

evidence.zh: 发布包无安装后执行钩子；开发脚本不随包分发；无未锁定版本的 git 依赖。
evidence.en: The release package has no post-install execution hooks; development scripts are not distributed with the package; no git dependencies with unlocked versions.

evidence.zh: 声明了 Web Client 半区并已审阅其编译产物，无键盘、剪贴板或凭据类危险调用。
evidence.en: The Web Client half-area is declared and its build artifact has been reviewed, with no dangerous calls for keyboard, clipboard, or credentials.

checked_items.zh: 运行时代码未发现任何出站网络调用（无请求库、无 WebSocket、无命令行外发）；代码中出现的网址只用于构造指向本机端口的图片地址，表情素材也由本机 Web 服务提供。
checked_items.en: No outbound network calls were found in runtime code (no request library, no WebSocket, no command-line exfiltration). URLs appearing in the code are only used to construct image addresses pointing to the local port; emoji assets are also served by the local web service.

checked_items.zh: 未发现读取敏感数据后编码变换再发送的外泄链、带外通道或 AI 端点/代理劫持配置（未设置任何非官方端点的环境变量）。
checked_items.en: No exfiltration chain, out-of-band channel, or AI endpoint/proxy hijack configuration was found (no environment variables set to non-official endpoints) after encoding transformations of read sensitive data.

checked_items.zh: 机器预扫未命中外联类规则（DSH-C03/DSH-C05 无命中），人工复核结论一致。
checked_items.en: The machine pre-scan did not hit outbound rules (DSH-C03/DSH-C05 no hits), and the manual review conclusion is consistent.

evidence.zh: 无外联代码路径；表情图片由本机服务路由提供，不产生出站流量。
evidence.en: No outbound code path exists; emoji images are routed and served by the local service, generating no outbound traffic.

checked_items.zh: 依赖清单核对：运行时依赖为 fflate、pngjs、mdast-util-from-markdown 与 @deepseek-ai 官方系列包，版本锁定明确，无可疑包名仿冒；未见未锁定版本的 git 依赖（DSH-S04 无命中）。
checked_items.en: Dependency manifest verification: runtime dependencies are fflate, pngjs, mdast-util-from-markdown, and the official @deepseek-ai package series, with explicit version locks and no suspicious package name impersonation. No git dependencies with unlocked versions were found (DSH-S04 no hit).

checked_items.zh: 无安装钩子、无下载即执行脚本（DSH-X02 无命中）。
checked_items.en: No install hooks and no download-and-execute scripts (DSH-X02 no hit).

checked_items.zh: 挂载配置不触碰沙箱、审批或权限配置行，不含禁用开关、环境变量降权或注入/拦截改写（DSH-P03/DSH-P04/DSH-P05 无命中）。
checked_items.en: The patch config does not touch sandbox, approval, or permission configuration lines, and contains no disable switches, environment variable downgrades, or injection/interception rewrites (DSH-P03/DSH-P04/DSH-P05 no hits).

checked_items.zh: 未发现对安全事件的高优先级监听（DSH-S01 无命中）；首次审计无上一版本基线，升级自动激活场景（DSH-S02）不适用。
checked_items.en: No high-priority listener for security events was found (DSH-S01 no hit); this is the first audit with no previous baseline, so the upgrade auto-activation scenario (DSH-S02) is not applicable.

checked_items.zh: 包名、仓库与作者信息一致，无名称仿冒或抢注迹象。
checked_items.en: Package name, repository, and author information are consistent, with no signs of name impersonation or squatting.

evidence.zh: 挂载配置仅插入插件自身标识，未触碰或禁用任何安全配置行。
evidence.en: The patch config only inserts the plugin's own identifier and does not touch or disable any security configuration lines.

evidence.zh: 插件未监听审批或预执行事件，无截断审批链的可能。
evidence.en: The plugin does not listen to approval or pre-execution events, so there is no possibility of truncating the approval chain.

evidence.zh: 首次审计，无上一版本基线可比较升级自动激活。
evidence.en: This is the first audit; there is no previous baseline to compare for upgrade auto-activation.

evidence.zh: 挂载配置未改写注入或拦截配置，不会拖垮其他插件服务。
evidence.en: The patch config does not rewrite injection or interception configurations, so it cannot bring down other plugins' services.

checked_items.zh: 插件不启动独立 Web 服务，仅在宿主已有 Web 服务上注册一个素材路由前缀；自有设置通道明确限定本机回环来源，未新增无认证访问面。
checked_items.en: The plugin does not start a standalone web service; it only registers an asset routing prefix on the host's existing web service. Its own settings channel is strictly limited to local loopback sources, adding no unauthenticated access surface.

checked_items.zh: 宿主本机无认证服务属生态固有风险，非本插件引入；本插件不监听端口、不启动服务。
checked_items.en: The host's local unauthenticated service is an inherent risk of the ecosystem, not introduced by this plugin. This plugin does not listen on any port or start a service.

evidence.zh: 插件未启动独立服务或监听端口，仅在宿主 Web 服务上注册素材路由；宿主无认证通道属生态固有风险，不由本插件新增。
evidence.en: The plugin does not start a standalone service or listen on a port; it only registers an asset route on the host's web service. The host's unauthenticated channel is an inherent ecosystem risk, not added by this plugin.

summary.zh: 身份与元数据核对通过：package.json 含 dsh 插件声明，包名、仓库与作者一致，无名称仿冒。
summary.en: Identity and metadata verification passed: package.json contains the dsh plugin declaration, and package name, repository, and author are consistent with no name impersonation.

summary.zh: 静态扫描未发现恶意执行面；7 条机械预扫命中全部经人工复核为良性工程代码。
summary.en: Static scanning found no malicious execution surface; all 7 machine pre-scan hits were manually reviewed as benign engineering code.

summary.zh: 行为分析未发现安装钩子、混淆载荷、凭据读取或出站外联。
summary.en: Behavior analysis found no install hooks, obfuscated payloads, credential reading, or outbound exfiltration.

summary.zh: AI 元数据审查通过：系统提示段与指令文件无注入措辞，无工具描述投毒。
summary.en: AI metadata review passed: the system prompt segment and instruction files contain no injection wording, and there is no tool-description poisoning.

summary.zh: 未做动态沙箱验证（上下文无沙箱产物）。
summary.en: No dynamic sandbox verification was performed (no sandbox artifacts in context).

limits.zh: 未做动态沙箱验证（上下文无沙箱产物）；机械规则扫描跳过的 35 个文件均为 assets/emoji/bilibili/ 下的二进制图片（AVIF 表情素材），非代码，已通过清单与目录结构人工确认；插件能力声明取自 package.json 的 dsh 字段并对照代码实测推断（无独立能力清单文件）；宿主 Web 服务无认证属 dsh 生态固有风险，已在 DG-D6 标注。
limits.en: No dynamic sandbox verification was performed (no sandbox artifacts in context). The 35 files skipped by machine rule scanning are binary images under assets/emoji/bilibili/ (AVIF emoji assets), not code, and were manually confirmed via manifest and directory structure. The plugin capability declaration was taken from the dsh field in package.json and cross-checked against actual code behavior (no separate capability manifest file). The host's unauthenticated web service is an inherent dsh ecosystem risk, noted in DG-D6.
